meta.name: process_groups
meta.description: The groups of the case types (the process packs, configs/processes/), in the order the New case page and the case list show them, each with its processes in their order (jav/app/process_packs.py `groups`). Every process pack stands in exactly one group; a pack another took the place of (`replaces`) shows its old cases under its successor's group. The titles are English; the interface translates them.

changelog.note: The Allianz corporate property quote, united with the insurance quote, is gone.
"From the mailbox to the packages", united with the mailbox download, is gone.
The two monthly reconciliations united with the monthly reconciliation are gone.
The first version (the owner's decision of 2026-11-02): four groups, Documents, Emails, Reconciliation and Quotes.
